Corollary
1. ch3:3.15Every compact Lie group admits a bi-invariant Riemannian metric.
Proof

\sketch The continuous image $\operatorname {Ad}(G)$ of compact $G$ is compact; apply Theorem 2.

□

If $\operatorname {Ad}(G)$ has compact closure, every adjoint orbit is bounded. An unbounded orbit therefore obstructs a bi-invariant metric.
